title: Implement service-level GATT-to-IPSO lookup table (K.2)
description:
Implement in lichen/subsys/lichen/gatt_ipso.c:

Static const table mapping GATT Service UUIDs to IPSO Object IDs per K.2:
- Environmental Sensing 0x181A
- Heart Rate 0x180D -> 3346
- Health Thermometer 0x1809 -> 3303
- Weight Scale 0x181D -> 3322
- Blood Pressure 0x1810 -> 3323
- Glucose 0x1808 -> 3325
- Body Composition 0x181B -> 26250
- Running Speed & Cadence 0x1814
- Cycling Speed & Cadence 0x1816
- Cycling Power 0x1818 -> 3328
- Location & Navigation 0x1819 -> 3336
- Indoor Positioning 0x1821 -> 3337
- Battery Service 0x180F -> 26251
- Automation IO 0x1815 -> 3200
- User Data 0x181C -> 26252
- Device Information 0x180A -> 3

~15 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.2
